mapper.sql: id, title, description, tag, published_at, image_content_type, image_filename, display_order, active, created_by, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO site_news (title, description, tag, published_at, image_data, image_content_type, image_filename, display_order, active, created_by) VALUES (#{title}, #{description}, #{tag}, #{publishedAt}, #{imageData}, #{imageContentType}, #{imageFilename}, #{displayOrder}, #{active}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE site_news SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, tag = #{tag}, published_at = #{publishedAt}, image_data = #{imageData}, image_content_type = #{imageContentType}, image_filename = #{imageFilename}, display_order = #{displayOrder}, active = #{active}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM site_news WHERE active = 1 ORDER BY display_order ASC, published_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM site_news ORDER BY display_order ASC, published_at DESC, id DESC
